phase3_findings.description: Acceptance criterion 9 unmet: docs/internal/claude-md-tiered-suite-rationale.md is absent from the diff and still describes the superseded two-call read-back at lines 231-234 (`scripts/workpad.py id <issue>` then `scripts/workpad.py body <comment-id>`, keyed on `id`'s exit-1/exit-2 vocabulary). AC9 explicitly requires that doc rewritten to the one-call `workpad.py body --issue <n>` form (exit 2 = absent, exit 3 = read failure), and requires a repo-wide sweep to leave no two-call read-back descriptions outside the deliberately-kept id-consuming surfaces (phase-1-setup.md §1.3, review/SKILL.md, implement/SKILL.md patch prose) and the two untouched workflow callers. This doc is the sole remaining offender, so both halves of AC9 fail. Corroborated by prflow:code-reviewer.

AC-required doc sweep incomplete: docs/internal/claude-md-tiered-suite-rationale.md lines 231-234 still describe the two-call `id`->`body <comment-id>` read-back — a plain prose description of the owed-fix-set read procedure, not a deliberately-kept id-consuming surface — so issue #2040's repo-wide sweep requirement (AC9) is unmet and the internal rationale doc still teaches the two-call pattern the feature retired. (Graded comment_drift/incomplete-sweep rather than documented_falsehood because the two-call form still works against HEAD.) Same defect as the prflow:requesting-code-review finding above.

Residual argparse exit-2 asymmetry on the positional arm: the design comment eliminates the argparse usage-error exit-2 vs absent-workpad exit-2 collision on the --issue arm (untyped string, validated in cmd_body) but leaves the positional `comment_id` as type=int, so `body notanint` is rejected by argparse with exit 2. Impact is limited (loud stderr, never routed by an --issue caller) and, per AC4, keeping the positional form byte-compatible actually requires the pre-existing type=int, so this asymmetry is largely intentional. Below threshold; no fix required.

pr-description/SKILL.md collapses the new exit vocabulary: `body --issue $ISSUE_NUMBER 2>/dev/null || true` maps exit 2 (absent), exit 3 (read failure) and operand errors alike to an empty WORKPAD_BODY, so a transient API failure is indistinguishable from a genuinely-absent workpad. AC7 explicitly sanctions this best-effort never-fail-the-run arm for this post-merge-item scrape, so acceptable as designed. Informational; no fix required.

Argparse wiring for the `body` subparser (comment_id -> nargs='?'/type=int/default=None, untyped --issue, added --marker) is never integration-tested: every operand-combination assertion drives cmd_body directly with a hand-built Namespace, so a regression dropping nargs='?' or restoring type=int on --issue would not be caught. Tests still satisfy AC10; a single end-to-end parse assertion would harden it. Below threshold; no fix required.

The non-list 'error envelope' exit-3 sub-path (a rc-0 gh response that parses but is not a JSON array) that the --issue arm inherits from _find_workpad_comment is not exercised directly on the new arm, nor is the _repo_full(api_fail_code=3) repo-resolution-failure exit-3 path; both are only transitively covered via the shared cmd_id/cmd_status tests. AC10's enumerated cases are met; a direct case would fully pin the new arm's exit-3 contract. Below threshold; no fix required.

## Verdict: REJECT (acceptance criterion 9 unmet — the required internal-doc sweep is incomplete)

Reviewed against issue #2040: "Add an issue-addressed `body --issue` read to workpad.py and collapse the two-fence workpad read-backs" — criteria from the issue body (`acceptance_criteria_source: issue-body`; head_override = local, diffed `main...HEAD`); scope unchanged. Requirement-based checklist items are included in the verification results below. 10 of 11 acceptance criteria are satisfied; AC9 is unmet.

- AC1–AC5 (scripts/workpad.py `cmd_body`): SATISFIED. The `--issue` arm resolves through `_workpad_marker(args.marker)` + the shared `_find_workpad_comment` scan (same as `id`/`status`), honoring `--marker`→env→config→default precedence and pagination, prints the matched comment body verbatim (exit 0), and yields exactly exit 3 (read failure, via `_repo_full(api_fail_code=3)` and `api_fail_code=3`) and exit 2 (clean-absent) as its only non-zero exits after validation. Operand validation (both/neither, and `issue.isascii() and issue.isdigit()` decimal check) exits 1 from inside `cmd_body` before any network call. `--issue` is an untyped string, avoiding the argparse usage-error exit-2 collision. Positional arm stays byte-compatible with an added operand-kind hint line before the existing `_fail` detail.
- AC6: SATISFIED — exactly six sites collapsed to the one-call form (phase-2-implement.md §2.0; phase-2-sweeps-contract.md criterion-lifecycle + ground-once-ledger; pr-description/SKILL.md; two implement/SKILL.md bullets).

- AC8: SATISFIED — id-consuming surfaces (phase-1-setup.md §1.3, review/SKILL.md id capture, implement/SKILL.md patch prose) untouched.
- AC9: **UNMET** — `docs/internal/claude-md-tiered-suite-rationale.md` was not modified and still describes the two-call read-back (lines 231–234); the repo-wide sweep requirement is therefore also unmet (this doc is the sole remaining offender).
